versions.subject: add exe webdav download
versions.detection:
selection_webdav:
    - c-useragent: '*WebDAV*'
    - c-uri: '*webdav*'
selection_executable:
    - resp_mime_types: '*dosexec*'
    - c-uri: '*.exe'
condition: selection_webdav AND selection_executable
